segments.speaker: LEAD
segments.text: Great Q3, team! We shipped 8 major features and hit 95% of our sprint commitments. Let's discuss what went well and what we can improve.

segments.speaker: MEM1
segments.text: I think our standups were really effective. Having clear daily goals helped us identify blockers early. We should keep this practice.

segments.speaker: MEM2
segments.text: Agreed. But I noticed our code review process was sometimes slow. We should establish SLA for code reviews - maybe 24 hours maximum.

segments.speaker: MEM3
segments.text: Quality improved significantly. We had fewer production bugs this quarter. The testing improvements we made really helped.

segments.speaker: LEAD
segments.text: Excellent observation. Monica, let's document what worked in testing and make it standard practice. What were the key improvements?

segments.speaker: MEM3
segments.text: We implemented automated integration tests and started testing on actual devices. This caught real issues that unit tests missed.

segments.speaker: MEM1
segments.text: One challenge was the last-minute feature requests. They disrupted our sprint planning. Can we be more strict about scope?

segments.speaker: LEAD
segments.text: Valid point. We'll implement a hard freeze 48 hours before sprint end. Anything else needs to wait for next sprint.

segments.speaker: MEM2
segments.text: I also want to suggest we do more knowledge sharing. Some team members had expertise that wasn't being leveraged.

segments.speaker: LEAD
segments.text: Great idea. Let's schedule weekly tech talks. Each team member presents something they learned. Who wants to go first in Q4?

segments.speaker: MEM1
segments.text: I'll present on the new API design patterns we used this quarter.

segments.speaker: LEAD
segments.text: Perfect. Let's also implement a 24-hour code review SLA and document our testing best practices. I'll schedule the first tech talk for next week.
